IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark hair wears
a black newsboy cap and a gray button-front knit
top with a cropped argyle cape collar. She wears
low-rise dark wash jeans and a slim leather belt
with a square gold buckle. A black jacket hangs
over one arm. Her expression is calm and direct. A
pink floral wallpaper backdrop and a wooden stool,
with warm soft light. Palette of gray, black, and
blush pink. Preppy and vintage, in the style of a
retro knitwear editorial.
